articles.summary: One of our values at Sift is “Ever Better”, meaning that we don’t settle for the status quo, and as an organization, are relentlessly curious. While I could think of many examples of how this value comes to life while working with my colleagues at Sift, our recent Hackathon was a testament to this value. […]
articles.title: Sift’s 2021 Hackathon brings the entire company together for innovation
